sources.snippet: The labeled data are used for model development through steps including data collection, model building, training, learning, and testing. Once trained, the detection model can accurately identify wildfire smoke in real-time. Alerts are then sent to emergency responders, enabling early action to prevent fire spread and minimize damage.
